brief: Make a short vertical video about the five parts of a modern AI agent: a language model, memory, tools, a planner and guardrails.
Make a short video revealing that training one frontier AI model can use as much electricity as 10,000 homes use in a year. End on that number.
Make a short video comparing a human proofreader, who checks about 200 pages a day, with an AI proofreader that checks 20,000 pages a day.
Explain photosynthesis for kids in four beats: sunlight, water, carbon dioxide, and the sugar the leaf makes.
Make a video about the zones of the ocean from the surface down: the sunlit zone, the twilight zone, the midnight zone and the abyss, and what lives in each.
Explain the layers of Earth's atmosphere from the ground up: troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere and thermosphere.
Make a short video about how water changes from ice to liquid water to steam, and at what temperatures those changes happen.
Make a video about compound interest: 1,000 dollars invested at 7 percent a year grows to about 7,600 dollars in 30 years. Build up to the final number.
Explain inflation with a cup of coffee that cost 1 dollar in the year 2000 and costs about 5 dollars today.
Make a short video that explains the 50/30/20 budget rule: needs, wants and savings.
Make a short history video about the Great Pyramid of Giza: built about 4,500 years ago from roughly 2.3 million stone blocks.
Make a video about how the printing press changed books: from one hand-copied book a month to hundreds of printed pages a day.
Make a short video about the 1969 Moon landing: the rocket, the lunar lander, the first footstep and the flag.
Make a hype video about the marathon world record: 42.195 kilometres in just over two hours.
Compare football and basketball by how many players each team has on the field: 11 versus 5.
Make a video listing what elite sprinters train: the start, acceleration, top speed, strength and recovery.
Explain the habit loop in a short video: cue, routine and reward.
Make a calm video about why sleep matters: adults need 7 to 9 hours, and one bad night can cut focus by about 30 percent.
Make me a cool video about space.
Something motivational for Monday morning.
